A '''carrion fly''' was an [[Insect/Legends|insect]] that fed on decomposing [[Death/Legends|corpses]]. It would fill itself so full with blood that it could only waddle.<ref name="Shatter">[[Shatterpoint (novel)|''Shatterpoint'']]</ref>
